ResearchDone.criterion: One scoped research question, architecture candidates, exact contrast and reopen conditions recorded before outcomes
Task/source ancestry, license, train/dev/final-test split, neutral outcome semantics and trusted scorer qualified
Development campaign phase closed; no family leakage into confirmation; manipulation and noise/cost feasibility documented

Each phase has its own frozen contract and exact authorization, ordered before its runs. RD4a-pre before P0; RD4a-dev before P1; RD4b after development freeze and before P2. No phase inherits later execution authority.
All assigned campaign outcomes, failures, interventions and full resource records closed; no silent replacement or missing legs
Preselected single-artifact held-out analysis, uncertainty, diagnostics and independent numeric rederivation completed
ArchitectureSelectionRecord applies predeclared positive/null/negative/inconclusive rule; no outcome-based goalpost change
Closed source/claim/run/unit/denominator evidence snapshot with support boundaries; broader prior art residual adjudicated

valid_null_negative: Can finish a fixed, adequately scoped programme. Absence of statistical significance alone is not equivalence/noninferiority.
inconclusive: Can close a bounded study with explicit uncertainty; cannot claim success or choose a graph winner from wide intervals.
invalid_only: Close as feasibility/instrument failure, never as efficacy; obtain an explicit paper-scope decision rather than endless repairs or success relabeling.
PublicationReady_after_writing: final figure bytes with proposed/instrument/result status
PrototypeReadiness_separate: ArchitectureSelectionRecord maps generic chosen design to internal owner/ports
event rules on permitted prebuilt/reused code clarified

Existing test-instance performance/high-score, repeated architecture validation and measured harness bottleneck requirements remain, including the active DeepVoice validation phase, plus explicit user native restart. This public study/review cannot waive or decouple them.
minimal end-to-end demo exercises actual candidate comparison and successor, not simulated multi-run status
not_required_to_begin_writing: finished figure pixels or final PDF metadata before manuscript exists
world-init/parity completion if not selected as task prerequisite

phase_authorities.requires: task and environment/scorer qualification; bounded apparatus scope; fixed completion/selection/failure/repair/ceiling contract; independent immutable review; exact user approval
P0 feasibility disposition; hash-bound arm differences; programme/block/repeat plan; development-only feedback; noise/precision/cost plan; distinct fixed envelope and exact approval

P1 closed; candidate and strongest simpler comparator frozen by recorded rule; one estimand/contrast/analysis; confirmation ancestry/sealing/contamination controls; new fixed envelope and exact approval

bounded_closure.P0_failure: Close the feasibility attempt and failure anatomy at its preregistered ceiling; no automatic manuscript gate or efficacy success. Explicit user paper-scope decision and closed evidence required for a feasibility-only thesis.
bounded_closure.P1_or_P2_ceiling: Stop authorized execution. Report reached stage and all missingness/cost. Budget exhaustion alone is not ResearchDone or permission to write. Complete the corresponding bounded analysis and explicit scope adjudication.
bounded_closure.valid_completed_campaign: Apply frozen useful-effect, uncertainty, cost and safety rules regardless of direction; no new reviews or repair rounds solely to obtain positive results.

prototype_inconclusive_rule: No efficacy winner. A reversible engineering default may be proposed only from actually feasibility/safety/cost-qualified candidates; if only C was assessed, do not infer cheaper B/G. User selection and native restart remain separate.
